output.summary: A tropical flowering tree from a Pacific source, believed to have been selectively bred in Polynesia from breadnut. It has large, deeply cut leaves, and every part yields latex. Its fruit is a staple in many tropical regions; ripe and unripe fruit are used, but unripe fruit is cooked before eating.
output.edibilityNote: Ripe fruit may be eaten raw or cooked; unripe fruit is cooked. Fruit is also dried into flour, and seeds are cooked.
